NativePrimitiveRecount.Method: Read saved generated Verilog, remove block comments, count V_* instantiations; no simulator or EDA invocation

Interpretation: Resource counts are taken from the routed build, then bound to the final programmed candidate by unchanged functional graph, FF placement and route evidence; this report does not run a fresh final-ADF utilization query.
36K and 18K RAM are one shared pool: 34 x 36K + 3 x 18K = 35.5 x 36K equivalent.
LUT-CONST and distributed RAM are reported separately and are not added again to the LUT total.
The dual eight-line stripe buffers add 16 physical 36K primitives relative to S3.
Clock resources CCS=1/1 and BKCL=5/6 constrain replication choices; no multi-lane timing, routability or throughput is inferred.
A newly rebuilt artifact must pass its own validation; the historic acceptance applies only to the recorded ADF/bitstream hashes.
